needed.suggestion: Extend and elevate the sidewalk on both sides to at least 1.5 meters width continuously.

needed.evidence: Obstructions on footway from parked vehicles
needed.suggestion: Install adequate physical barriers to prevent parking encroachment onto the footway.

needed.evidence: Uneven sections on footways may cause tripping hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair uneven sections and ensure consistent, level footway surfaces.

needed.evidence: No proper refuge or signalisation at marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island or signalised crossing to provide a safer crossing facility for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing not clearly visible, potential for high-speed crossing
needed.suggestion: Improve crossing visibility by adding high-visibility road markings and consider lowering speed limits near the crossing.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs at the crossing
needed.suggestion: Add kerb ramps or raised platforms at the crossing to facilitate accessibility and improve crossing safety.
